FIELDS.NAME: Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair specializes in the retail of footwear and provides a variety of shoe repair services, ensuring customer satisfaction by employing skilled technicians. Our operations are designed to maintain a clean, well-organized environment that complies with local safety codes. We focus on offering high-quality repair solutions using non-hazardous materials. Our knowledgeable staff is trained in customer service and operational safety protocols, which are regularly updated to uphold industry standards. We prioritize a strong safety record, having implemented corrective measures for any past claims, and continue to engage with our community through local events and promotions to enhance our brand presence. Additionally, we maintain a robust inventory management system to meet seasonal demands, ensuring availability and variety for our customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in equipment rental or leasing and confirms that all fixed-location premises are well-maintained and compliant with local safety codes. Additionally, any mobile shoe repair services operate exclusively with properly insured commercial vehicles, adhering to all geographic service area restrictions and local licensing requirements.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 10, 2022, a slip-and-fall incident occurred in our store due to a customer leaving a wet umbrella on the floor. The total cost of the claim was $1,200, which was settled without any ongoing issues. The status is resolved, and corrective measures, including enhanced floor signage and staff training on maintaining clear walkways, have been implemented.
